prompt.content: What was the name of the island where Tom Weisner and his wife were stationed during their time with the Peace Corps?

output:
The name of the island where Tom Weisner and his wife were stationed during their time with the Peace Corps is **Kiritimati (Christmas Island)**.

Kiritimati is the largest island in the Kiritimati Atoll, part of the Republic of Kiribati in the Pacific
